proposal.blind_spot: The optimizer can see memory dominates but cannot tell irreducible roofline traffic from inflated traffic (missing write bytes) or whether the real choke point is the L1/LSU sector path rather than DRAM itself.

rationale.dram__bytes_write.sum: HIGH (read+write far above the logical tensor footprint) -> hunt redundancy: fuse ops, keep intermediates in registers, guarantee one load/store per element, fix uncoalesced stores / LOW (total ~= footprint) -> kernel is at the bandwidth roofline, so stop rewriting access patterns and only reduce bytes (dtype, single-pass) or leave it unchanged
rationale.l1tex__throughput.avg.pct_of_peak_sustai: HIGH -> L1/LSU pipe is the limiter, so cut sector/request count with vectorized contiguous loads and warp-contiguous thread-to-data mapping / LOW while DRAM is high -> datapath has headroom, so attack traffic and latency instead (prefetch, async copies, more ILP, byte reduction)
